specs.title: lost revision creation receipts survive refresh and recover the same draft with the original command
archive, withdrawal reasons, restore, keyboard cancellation and responsive impact previews use real saved states
a lost publication reply recovers after refresh without another publication or another lesson version
a stale publication preview reads the actual saved version before a new explicit confirmation
stopping a lost publication wait preserves the committed command and ignores its late reply
